name: Puppeteer MCP
tagline: Browser automation and web scraping via a real headless Chrome.
shortDescription: A reference MCP server that drives a real Chromium browser via Puppeteer. Navigate, click, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract rendered HTML. The right tool when JS rendering matters.
longDescription:
## What it does

Launches a headless Chromium that your agent can drive. Navigate to URLs, click elements, fill form fields, wait for selectors, take screenshots, and extract rendered HTML (after JS executes).

## Why we recommend it

When the page is JS-rendered (SPAs, React apps, anything with a build step), Fetch and HTTP scrapers return empty or useless HTML. Puppeteer runs the JS and gives you the real DOM.

## When to use it

- Scraping SPAs (Gmail, Notion public pages, dashboards)
- Automating logins or form fills
- Taking screenshots for visual testing
- Testing your own web app from an agent

## When NOT to use it

- Simple static pages (use Fetch)
- Bulk crawling (use Firecrawl)
- High-frequency scraping (browser startup is slow)
installInstructions:
1. The first run downloads Chromium (~170MB) automatically
2. Set `PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH` if you want to use a system-installed browser
3. Screenshots are saved to the current directory by default; configure with `PUPPETEER_OUTPUT_DIR`
